blocks.text: MANILA – Rotational brownouts are possible in Cebu today, October 23, as the Visayas and Mindanao grids continue to face supply constraints, prompting the extension of yellow and red alerts. The National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) said the Visayas grid is on red alert from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m., while the yellow alert is in effect from 4 p.m. to 5 p.m. and from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. Available capacity is around 2,407 megawatts (MW) while peak demand is expected to reach 2,558MW.
